spans.s: ओदती [ōdatī], Issuing out, rising upwards; epithet of the Dawn; नदं व ओदतीनाम्
Food, boiled rice; e. g. दध्योदनः, घृत˚, गुड˚, मांस˚ &c.
Grain mashed and cooked with milk.
A cloud. (Sometimes ओदन is prefixed to the names of pupils to denote that the pupil's object is more to be fed by his master than be taught; e. g. ओदनपाणिनीयाः
. -नी The plant (बला) Sida Cordifolia (Mar. चिकणा). -Comp. -आह्वया, -आह्वा, -ओदनिका N. of a medicinal plant (महासमंगा).
ओदनीयति [ōdanīyati], Den. P. To wish to make mashed food of anything; पुरोडाशं यद्योदनीयन्ति.
